end.summary:
Matched numerals to groups in two easy questions; a new-situation or why question is still to check.
Matched “one/ek” to numerals in two easy questions; a new-situation or why question is still to check.
Practised reading and writing 6/9 and 2/5; some were right, but the direction is not steady yet.
Practised zero for none; one response was right, and the idea is still building.
end.parentNote: Asha practised matching numerals with groups, connecting “one/ek” to 1, and reading and writing numerals. Aarav used the helpful method of noticing whether the round part of 6 is below and 9 is above; this was right in some examples but needs more practice with 6/9 and 2/5. There was a mix-up about zero: Aarav first suggested one, then later said that no birds were left and gave “zero”; this was corrected after the first response, but needs another check. At home, show small groups of objects, including an empty group, and ask Aarav to choose and write the matching numeral.
